purpose: Deterministic Blender-derived stage and neutral role-position controls for future adapter experiments. It does not modify or instantiate frozen gauntlet semantics.

no_change_protocol.scope: Only deterministic Blender control construction; every image-renderer adapter must run and assess its own no-change controls.

limitations: Colored cuboids are neither characters nor identity controls.
The r1 source anchor labels are character-named while this camera projects world X-negative to screen-right; therefore this bundle must not support G07 panel-left/panel-right semantic scoring.
No actual image-renderer run, set texture, camera match, final visible art, or frozen benchmark score is established.
freeze_gate: Version neutral world-coordinate anchors and an explicit world-to-comic-panel projection map (ADR-0012).
Select a renderer adapter and version its control ingestion/workflow.
Run renderer-specific no-change and error-injection controls.
Calibrate a separately declared comic camera against approved production reference.
Do not alter gauntlet semantic intent while doing so.
